params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { input: [{ key, type, label, placeholder?, required?, options? }], outcome: 'stat'|'table'|'code'|'text' }.

params.name: Run
params.doc: Runs the action with the values of the input fields, keyed by field key (read text with GetString(), a number with GetDouble()). What it returns is drawn as the outcome: for text a string or an object with text, for stat an object with value and label, for table an object with columns and rows, for code a string or an object with code. Throwing shows the error state with Retry.

notes: run(values) is a callback property, set from script: the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Run parameter. A Run that throws rejects the JavaScript promise, which the element shows as its error state with Retry.
